item.title: Gerber recalls some arrowroot biscuits over potential plastic or paper pieces
item.description: CBS Gerber is recalling some of its arrowroot biscuits over potential contamination of soft plastic and paper pieces, the Food and Drug Administration announced Wednesday. item.title: Vols Beat Georgia 86-85 in Overtime to Give Coach Barnes His 850th Career Victory
item.description: (utsports.com)– The University of Tennessee men’s basketball team logged its second road win in five days with an 86-65 overtime decision Wednesday night at Georgia. Tennessee (14-6, 4-3 SEC) trailed by six at halftime at Stegeman Coliseum, but its stellar second-half shooting provided head coach Rick Barnes the 850th victory of his illustrious 39-year career. item.title: Calhoun Edges Heritage 77-73
item.description: Ringgold, GA-(WDEF-TV) After falling behind early, Calhoun rallied to beat Heritage 77-73. Trace Hawkins hit two big free throws with 11 seconds left to help seal the Yellow Jackets victory. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Bradley Central Downs East Hamilton 55-43
item.description: Cleveland, TN-(WDEF-TV) After leading by four at halftime, Bradley Central went on to beat East Hamilton 55-43 on Wednesday night at Jim Smiddy Arena. Jayden Haywood led the Hurricanes with 16 points on 7-of-8 shooting from the floor. Jermiah Brownlow topped the Bears scoring attack with 16 points as well. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
